place.source_title: Gaines Hardy Roberts House, Wonderland Route

brief: Square two-storey brick house of 1839 with a hipped roof, paired interior chimneys, five bays, a plain entrance and a later rear wing; neglected, with overgrown shrubs. Record: 1 photo plus 9 measured drawing sheets.

facade.notes: the Gaines Hardy Roberts House (Newburgh IN, 1839): a three-storey house with stuccoed front and stone gable ends with big paired end chimneys, five bays, white shutters, an iron balconette over the door, high steps; big trees on a rough lawn

why.note: an Ohio River trader's three-storey house: wealth from river commerce
